title: Reefer Cargo Services: goodwill waiver of a reefer fee
content:
## Scope

This clause of **Reefer Cargo Services** sets when the reefer desk may waive a fee on a reefer service as goodwill, which fees qualify, and the limits of amount, frequency and timing. The tier referred to is the tier of the reefer service on which the fee was booked.

## Rule

1. The desk may waive **one fee row** as goodwill at the customer's request.
2. Only setting change fees, late request fees, cancellation fees and terminal plug-in and monitoring fees may be waived. Inspection fees, special service charges and remote monitoring fees are **never** waived.
3. A waiver cancels the **whole** referenced fee row: the waiver is for the full amount of that row.
4. The fee row's amount must **not exceed** the tier's goodwill waiver authority.
5. The customer's reefer goodwill waivers in the trailing 365 days must be **fewer than** the tier's allowance. The trailing period is the 365 calendar days ending on the waiver date, that date included, and it counts waivers across all of the customer's reefer services.
6. The waiver must be requested no later than the tier's waiver window after the fee being waived was booked. The window ends on the fee's booking date plus the tier's window days, counted on calendar dates, and a request on the last day is inside it.
7. Each fee row is waived **at most once**.
8. The amount, booking date and charge of the fee row, and the customer's earlier waivers, are read from the company's ledger records.

## Tier table

| Tier | Largest single fee row the desk may waive | Goodwill waivers per customer per trailing 365 days | Request window after the fee was booked |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Standard | 0.00 USD | 0 | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | 50.00 USD | 1 | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | 100.00 USD | 1 | 30 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | 150.00 USD | 2 | 45 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | 200.00 USD | 2 | 45 calendar days |
| AHL Reefer Superfreezer | 150.00 USD | 1 | 30 calendar days |

On AHL Reefer Standard the allowance is 0, and no count of earlier waivers can be fewer than 0, so no goodwill waiver is available on that tier.

## Checklist

| Check | Passes when |
|---|---|
| Fee type | Setting change, late request, cancellation, or terminal plug-in and monitoring fee |
| Amount of the fee row | Equal to or below the tier's authority |
| Earlier waivers for the customer in the trailing 365 days | Fewer than the tier's allowance |
| Date of the request | On or before the last day of the window |
| Fee row already waived? | No |

If any check fails, the fee row is not waived as goodwill.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical fee rows)

| Tier | Fee row | Other facts | Result |
|---|---|---|---|
| AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere | Cancellation fee of 150.00 USD | No earlier waivers; inside the window | Waived in full: the amount equals the authority |
| AHL Reefer Cold Treatment | Plug-in fee of 120.00 USD | No earlier waivers | Not waived: above the 100.00 USD authority |
| AHL Reefer Monitored | Setting change fee | One earlier reefer waiver 200 days ago | Not waived: 1 is not fewer than 1 |
| AHL Reefer Pharma GDP | Late request fee | One earlier reefer waiver in the trailing period | The count of 1 is fewer than 2 |
| Any tier | Pre-trip inspection fee | Any | Never waived |

**Trailing period edge.** An earlier waiver dated 364 days before the waiver date falls inside the trailing 365 days; one dated 365 days before falls outside.

**Window edge (hypothetical fee booked on 10 January).** On AHL Reefer Controlled Atmosphere the window ends on 24 February: a request on 24 February is inside, on 25 February outside. On AHL Reefer Monitored the window ends on 9 February.

## Basis Q&A

**Can the desk waive half of a plug-in fee?** No. A waiver cancels the whole referenced row.

**The customer's earlier waiver was on a different reefer service. Does it count?** Yes. The trailing count covers all of the customer's reefer services.
